propositions: Fixture setup consumes 47% of tests/interfaces wall-clock (361.4s setup / 391.0s call) due to function-scoped rebar_repo running git init, config, and rebar.init_repo per test at 306 ms per invocation across 589 test functions.

Session-scoped template built once per xdist worker and shallow-copied per test achieves 306 ms → 22.3 ms (13.7x speedup) but requires four fixups to maintain test isolation: worktree pointer rewriting, gate snapshot store keying, environment identity re-randomization, and module-global cache reset.

Bare git worktree repair silently fails to update stale gitdir pointers and leaves copies pointing to the template's object store, causing writes in one copy to advance other stores' refs and making template contamination invisible until checked by git worktree list --porcelain validation.

Template fixture must build in an isolated MonkeyPatch context with REBAR_ROOT, XDG_CONFIG_HOME, and environment variables pinned to prevent autouse fixtures from the first requester from being baked into the session template under xdist worksteal.

Sentinel tests must prove half-fixed copies (single pointer rewritten) and bare-repair copies are rejected by the worktree list guard, that template remains virgin (no tickets, no .rebar/), and that .env-id and .signing-key are unconditionally re-randomized per copy rather than idempotently guarded.
